'''Suva-Rak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Voss commandos|Commando]] who lived on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was stationed as a guard at the [[Pilgrim Retreat]] at the [[Old Paths]], where he asked an off-worlder to cleanse the monuments on the road to the [[Shrine of Healing]] that were defiled by [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]].
